svg.title: Site for the second distribution centre
svg.desc: A weighted decision matrix: 4 options scored against 5 weighted criteria. The computed weighted totals rank Salt Lake City 77, Phoenix 67, Reno 60, Boise 57; Salt Lake City wins and its column is tinted green, and a final row gives each option's difference from the Reno datum.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Salt Lake City wins with 77 points, 17 ahead of the Reno datum; Phoenix is second with 67.

text.font-family: Inter, Helvetica Neue, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each cell shows the score and, beneath it, the points it earns: the score times the criterion’s weight.
